BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 1,030,484 of its own ordinary shares between August 17 and August 21, 2026, with prices ranging from 73.60 pence to 75.70 pence per share. These repurchased shares will be cancelled. Following these transactions, the company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 338,982,045 shares, with 3,867,640 held in treasury. The number of shares available for shareholder notification calculations is now 335,114,405. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 24 August 2026 24 August 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 17 August 2026 18 August 2026 19 August 2026 20 August 2026 21 August 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 225,978 228,625 137,380 310,495 57,866 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 74.80 74.70 74.60 75.70 75.70 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 73.60 74.20 74.20 74.10 75.20 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 74.2621 74.5471 74.4349 74.6327 75.4389 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 338,982,045 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 3,867,640 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 335,114,405 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
